description: Telangana to establish India's first Green Pharma focused Applied AI Centre of Excellence
body_lead: The Government of Telangana, in collaboration with Microsoft India 1M1B (1 Million for 1 Billion) and MeitY Startup Hub, has announced the establishment of India's first Green Skills & Applied AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) dedicated to Green Pharma. The initiative marks a significant step towards strengthening Telangana's position as a global hub for sustainable life sciences manufacturing while building a future-ready talent ecosystem.
